jobs.title: Property Data Collection Specialist (Drone Operator) - Destin/Panama City, FL
jobs.description:
#### **Pay: $50,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year**

The Property Data Collection Specialist at Bees360 is responsible for operating an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone) and mobile technology to capture high-quality property data for major insurance carriers. This role combines fieldwork, technology, and customer interaction, requiring strong attention to detail, efficiency, and professionalism.

Bees360 offers a performance-driven compensation model that provides income stability through a guaranteed base while allowing Specialists to significantly increase earnings through productivity and efficiency. Must have a compatible drone.

#### **Compensation Overview:**

Guaranteed Base Pay: $2,400 per month

Production Pay: $11 per completed credit

#### **Monthly Productivity Bonus (Incremental):**

161–180 credits +$4 per credit

181–200 credits +$6 per credit

201+ credits +$10 per credit

#### **Example Earnings:**

A Specialist completing 220 credits in a month could earn:

Base Pay: $2,400

Production Pay: $2,420

Bonus: $400

Total: $5,220/month (~$62,000+ annually)

Top performers can earn significantly more based on productivity and routing efficiency.

Job Description (Essential Duties and Responsibilities)

* Perform image and data collection using drones and mobile devices (Android/iOS)
* Conduct preflight and postflight drone operations, including airspace coordination
* Operate drones safely in compliance with FAA regulations and company policies
* Capture highquality images from multiple angles for accurate property analysis
* Troubleshoot technical challenges including signal interference, battery issues, and calibration
* Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and proper storage
* Perform quality checks to meet client requirements
* Communicate with insureds to explain inspection processes
* Collaborate with managers on scheduling, routing, and performance expectations
* Utilize Bees360 platforms for scheduling, reporting, and workflow management
* Maintain assigned territory and travel as required
* Report incidents promptly to management
* Maintain professionalism and deliver a positive customer experience
* Perform other duties as assigned

#### **Required Equipment**

* FAAcompliant drone (DJI preferred; approved list provided upon request)
* Smartphone or tablet capable of supporting inspection applications
* Reliable vehicle with valid insurance
* Equipment capable of supporting an 8+ hour daily workload

#### **Required Skills/Abilities**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problemsolving and analytical abilities
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to manage time, routes, and workload efficiently
* Technical proficiency with mobile apps and data platforms
* Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fastpaced environment
* Customerfocused mindset with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to identify and communicate delays or issues proactively
* Collaborative and teamoriented approach

#### **Education and Training Required**

* High School Diploma or GED required
* FAA Part 107 Certification required

#### **Years of Experience**

* 13 years of relevant experience preferred (drone operations, inspections, or field services)

#### **Physical Requirements**

* Ability to perform physically demanding work including standing, walking, kneeling, bending, and climbing
* Ability to lift and carry equipment up to 60 pounds
* Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
* Ability to walk on uneven terrain and navigate inspection environments
* Willingness to travel and drive for extended periods

#### **Equal Opportunity Employment Statement**

Our employment practices are in accord with the laws which prohibit discrimination due to race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, active military status, citizenship status, marital status or any other consideration made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws.

Join Bees360 and take control of your earnings while working with industry-leading drone technology. Apply today.

#### **Benefits:**

Dental insurance

Health insurance

Health savings account

Life insurance

Paid time off

Vision insurance

#### **License/Certification:**

Part 107 Certification (Required)

Work Location: On the road
